title: Turn Xcode Graph Quirks Into Agent-Tested Fixtures
summary: Pedro Piñera explains that after BuildOnce can process an Xcode workspace and compile and run its products, he asks a coding agent to preserve the graph's unusual cases as lightweight test fixtures. The accumulating fixture suite turns each newly supported workspace shape into regression coverage on the path toward swift-build compatibility.
takeaway: After making a real Xcode workspace pass, have the agent reduce its unusual graph shape into a small fixture and add that fixture to the compatibility suite before moving on.
